phase_policies.applies_when: Early game with both sides having heavy economy and technology, but no clear army composition yet. No reliable combat-unit cues from the opponent.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have more scouting information or when you hit a tech milestone.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize tech and economy, keep production moderate, expand, and avoid early army overcommitment.
phase_policies.target: Develop economy and technology while maintaining a flexible army composition. Continue expanding and increasing production.
phase_policies.title: Tech and Economy Focus
phase_policies.veto: Avoid over-investing in army early when opponent is unknown, which may delay tech and economy.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-midgame phase with both sides having heavy economy and technology, but own army composition still unclear. Opponent shows a ground posture with Stalker cues.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have more information about the opponent's army composition or when you reach a new tech milestone.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Focus on ground army strength, keep economy and tech developing, maintain expansion and production.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen your ground army while continuing to develop your economy and technology. Maintain your current expansion and production.
phase_policies.title: Ground Development with Heavy Tech
phase_policies.veto: Avoid neglecting detection or anti-air when both sides are heavy ground, risking a surprise air transition.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame phase where both sides have heavy ground armies and heavy tech. Own army includes Stalkers and Immortals, while opponent shows Zealot cues.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent shows signs of transitioning to air or if you face a timing attack.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground with Immortals, maintain economy and expansion, watch for air transition or timing.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening your ground army, adding more Immortals and supporting units. Keep expanding and increasing your economy.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Macro with Immortal Support
phase_policies.veto: Avoid being too passive when opponent has heavy ground and detection, allowing them to build up for a timing attack.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-midgame phase with both sides having heavy ground armies and heavy tech. Own army includes Stalkers, Observers, and Immortals, while opponent shows Stalker, Sentry, WarpPrism, and Observer cues.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent transitions to air or if you need to add splash damage.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground with Immortals, ensure detection, maintain economy and expansion, watch for air or splash needs.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening your ground army, adding more Immortals and ensuring you have detection. Maintain your economy and expansion.
phase_policies.title: Late-Mid Ground Army with Observer and Immortal
phase_policies.veto: Avoid neglecting detection or anti-air when both sides are heavy ground, risking a surprise air transition.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
